attack_surfaces.reason: argv[1]/argv[2] are dereferenced via mov rax,[rax] without checking argc>=3 or pointer validity; missing args cause NULL dereference segfault. This is a robustness/DoS issue, not a memory corruption primitive. The dereferenced data flows into DES crypto operations (key schedule + ECB encrypt) and is written to stdout via write(1,...,8). No heap, no format string, no index-based OOB.
